gate_adjudication_for_signoff: My reading, stated for sign-off: the #965-endorsed disjunction covers families ADJUDICATED as comparison-limits - 'the divergence is in the comparison, not the engine' must be ESTABLISHED, not presumed. The 134 WHAT-level candidate rows (the structural component-count family, 4 other named shapes, and the unresolved generic fallback pool) do not meet that bar: their WHY is open. Attributed-as-candidate therefore does NOT satisfy the certification gate. A sweep that observes these shapes at rate can only PASS if, by launch time, each shape has been adjudicated to a WHY (fix, documented engine follow-up, or proven comparison-limit). If the WHY round closes them as comparison-limits, expected-at-rate presence is consistent with certification; if it fixes them, they join the predicted-zero set; until one of those happens, certification is blocked on them.
